text: Redmond Rovers' equalizer at 37' epitomizes their tactical approach under Ilse Marchetti in a 4-3-3 setup, using a structured, possession-based build-up that began from a free kick and involved 6 passes over 19.7 seconds. The sequence combined progressive passing triggers—including a long, progressive pass by Rory Mensah into the final third—and spatial manipulation through quick circulation to outmaneuver Ironvale’s 5-3-2 low block and deep defensive line [#682-#690]. Despite a low xG of 0.016 from Mensah’s 26.4m shot, the goal reflects Redmond’s patience in transitioning from resting defense into controlled attack, leveraging field tilt (55.2%) and superior possession (57.0%) to create shooting opportunities without resorting to high-risk penetrations. Ironvale’s PPDA of 10.0 indicates aggressive pressing, yet Redmond’s elevated PPDA of 26.0 during this phase demonstrates effective pressing triggers and overloads that neutralized Ironvale’s counter-attacking threat, allowing them to sustain progressive passes and balance defensive responsibilities with offensive control.
